title: Replace plaintext credential fields in the db-models Secrets document with Secrets Manager locators
description: In applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master/onfinance_db_model_master/models.py, change class Secrets(Document) (lines 8-15) as follows. Remove zerodha_password and zerodha_2fa entirely (use Kite Connect request/access token flow instead of stored login credentials). Replace apiKey, apiSecrets and accessToken with StringFields that hold only an AWS Secrets Manager ARN or locator (e.g. api_secret_ref, access_token_ref). Replace User.user_binance_auth_creds (line 397, DynamicField) with a typed EmbeddedDocument that holds only a locator. If a token must stay in MongoDB, use MongoDB client-side field-level encryption with a KMS-held key, not a plain field. Any new dependency goes into setup.py pinned and sourced from https://pypi.org/simple (dependencyPolicy.allowedRegistries, lockfilesRequired). Bump the package major version because the change is breaking, and document the migration in the repo changelog. Constraints: normal change, 1 approval, rollback plan required. The repo has no CI (ciSystem none), so run tests locally and attach the output to the PR. Only the dev environment (isolated) is recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: In models.py no field of Secrets holds apiKey, apiSecrets or accessToken values as a plain StringField (only *_ref locator fields or CSFLE-encrypted fields exist), and User.user_binance_auth_creds is no longer a DynamicField
setup.py carries a bumped major version and every added dependency is pinned with ==
Re-running probe-schemas produces no SCH-PII-02 fail result at onfinance_db_model_master/models.py

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on db-models/onfinance-db-model-master at the merged commit. Expect no SCH-PII-02 result for onfinance_db_model_master/models.py and fingerprint 5ecce787... absent, so the ledger can resolve fnd_01M2GMN61NFQDTRGPZ5RMSMTWN (first raised by probe-schemas, re-confirmed by execute-scr).

rootCause.description: The shared mongoengine model declares broker and exchange credentials as plain StringField/DynamicField with no encryption hook or locator pattern, so every consumer persists them in cleartext BSON.
